method: For each pinned module, generate the explicit 0x1000 synthetic relocation image from the static IOP model; parse relocated exports; subtract 0x1000 to get section-relative targets; classify against the independent saved Ghidra listing ranges keyed by raw module SHA. A target status is only a coverage/listing classification, not proof of callable semantics.
claim_limits: Load base 0x1000 is a reproducibility fixture, not a runtime address.
Listing categories are exact interval comparisons against a saved Ghidra database and do not establish correct decoding, callability, symbol identity, or OS registration.
Unowned/undefined targets are not automatically promoted or disassembled.
